[SWS_CRYPT_01204] Update
⌈
The function Update shall implement the
configured hash algorithm calculation.
⌋

[SWS_CRYPT_01204] Update
⌈
The functions ara::crypto::cryp:-
:MessageAuthnCodeCtx::Update,
ara::crypto::cryp::MessageAuthn-
CodeCtx::Update,
ara::crypto::cryp::MessageAuthnCodeCtx::Update
shall update the digest calculation context by a new part of the message. The functions
shall return:
• kProcessingNotStarted error, if the digest calculation was not initiated by a
call of the Start() method.
⌋
